stories.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
stories.one_liner: TokenRouter is a new serving system designed to efficiently handle token-level LLM routing in inference work.
stories.summary: Large language model routing distributes inference work across different models. Coarse-grained routing at the session or query level is common in production systems, but token-level routing offers efficiency and quality gains. Current systems face challenges like step desynchronization and batch admission delays under token-level routing. Researchers designed TokenRouter to solve these challenges. TokenRouter uses request-centric programming and model-centric execution. It launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver uses a delayed-batching scheduler. TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs.
stories.eli5: When you have two different AI helpers, TokenRouter is like a smart traffic cop that decides word by word which helper should write the next part.
stories.why_it_matters: Higher decoding throughput makes token-level routed large language model inference practical for production systems.

stories.title: SparseDecoding Proposes Decoding-Aware Pruning for LLM Inference
stories.one_liner: SparseDecoding is a decoding-aware pruning framework designed to improve accurate and efficient large language model inference.
stories.summary: Large language model inference suffers from significant latency during the decoding stage because of its memory-bound nature. Layer-wise training-free network pruning guided by the Hessian is a known solution, but typical methods compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences. This creates a distribution shift from self-generated tokens. SparseDecoding addresses this by constructing calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill. This aligns the pruning objective with decoding activations.
